dataset.name: Independent papillary renal cell carcinoma atlas (2025)
dataset.description: Papillary renal cell carcinomas from a 219-tumor Japanese rare-kidney-cancer transcriptome atlas, with public gene counts and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Central pathology was used to retain papillary RCC only. Every endpoint-complete participant has one eligible RNA-seq tumor in this subset.

metadata.source_program: Comparative transcriptome atlas of rare kidney cancers
metadata.library_method: Gene-level bulk RNA-seq counts normalized by TRACE Explorer to log2(CPM + 1)
metadata.curation_note: Eligibility is outcome-independent and requires central pathology Papillary RCC, an RNA-seq matrix column, positive follow-up time and a published 0/1 vital-status code.

samples.sample_role: Resected tumor used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: Figshare counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GENCODE gene names supplied in the pinned Figshare count matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Source gene names duplicated across GENCODE rows are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous gene-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library sizes across every source gene row for each retained sample, converts each count to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1).

endpoints.label: Overall survival from surgery
endpoints.time_origin: Date of surgery for the profiled tumor
